# Monash University Research Portal

> Monash University's research portal connecting researchers, facilitating collaboration, and showcasing innovation across Australia's research-intensive institution.

The portal serves as a centralized hub for Monash University's research community, featuring researcher directories and collaboration opportunities. The site prioritizes accessibility compliance and uses Cloudflare security services to protect user data.

## Key Topics

- Monash University
- research portal
- researcher directory
- collaboration opportunities
- research-intensive

## Research Portal

- [Monash University](https://research.monash.edu): Monash University research portal with researcher directory and collaboration opportunities

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility Statement](https://research.monash.edu/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance and accessibility statement for screen readers and keyboard navigation

## Optional

- [Email Protection](https://research.monash.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection service for spam and bot prevention
